CA.rationale: A (attention/processing relation) is absent in the report.

COD.rationale: Content (colored cell coordinates), an organization/presentation (coordinate listing / grid orientation) and a distinct origin/status are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to the identified contents' presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report names specific perceptual/display contents (color assignments to coordinate sets).

D.rationale: Origins/status metadata (completed_record vs history_estimate/command_estimate) are attributed separately from the content coordinate listings.

O.rationale: The report specifies how contents are presented (coordinate lists and grid orientation), i.e. organized/presented.
